description: In every PA-model, left unpairing of the specified square-pair code of \((a,b)\) returns \(a\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.unpairLeft_pair_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (a b : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.unpairLeft.value
      ![Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.squarePair.value ![a, b]] =
    a
